notes.title: Notice of Update Implementation
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing BRAVE mini. 

Today we have implemented the following update.

Update Information

Implementation of the auto-save function
Added an option function to the title.
From the options, you can delete saved data, set the volume, and check credits.
Added a function to set the volume.
Changed some of the game effects.
11 achievements have been added.
Fixed some bugs.
